name: Complex aggregation on financial data
sql:
SELECT principal_activities, COUNT(company_name) AS company_count,
       AVG(CAST(revenue AS FLOAT)) AS avg_revenue,
       SUM(CAST(total_assets AS FLOAT)) AS total_assets_sum
FROM finance
GROUP BY principal_activities
HAVING COUNT(company_name) >= 2
LIMIT 50
reason: Financial values require parsing from long documents; principal_activities is multi-valued
